Neighbouring tests (base tests/test_console.py ~872, 882, 898) use an in-body `if console.legacy_windows: return` guard, and test_show_cursor (~291) pins legacy_windows=False. On Windows with a StringIO file, fileno() raises, so the legacy path is not taken (base rich/console.py:1935-1944) and the text path writes the sequence (_render_buffer 1973-1990). The assertion would therefore hold on Windows, and the skip hides a test that could run.
